WASM-BLOCK.description: Forbidden Wasm-host APIs. Use dart:js_interop instead.

UTC-BLOCK.description: DateTime.now() must always be followed by .toUtc().

FINANCIAL-BLOCK.description: Use BIGINT cents instead of double for financial calculations.

SRP-UI-LEAK.description: Supabase calls leaked into UI layer. Use a Repository/Handler.

DDD-BAD-NAMES.description: Generic variable/method naming in Domain layer. Use CanonicalFact, LedgerEntry, etc.

CQRS-LEAK.description: Handlers must return void or IDs (CQRS violation).

INV1-BLOCK.description: Every Handler must inject TenantValidationService and call assertTenantMatches() (INV-1: Identity Sovereignty).

INV-26-REPO.description: Every file making Supabase calls MUST implement PostgresErrorInterceptor (INV-26: Error Parity).

INV-30-CHECK.description: INV-30 violation: Direct Supabase.instance.client access outside bootstrap (main.dart, supabase_provider.dart). Use DI via constructor or supabaseClientProvider.

HMAC-SIGN-CHECK.description: INV-31: Ingestion/ledger Edge Functions MUST import hmac_signer.ts for HMAC signing (Zero-Knowledge integrity).

INV-DB.description: Destructive migration operation. Use soft-delete, triggers, or non-blocking constraints (INV-DB: Zero-Downtime).

INV6-TIMESTAMP-TZ.description: INV-6 (Universal UTC): timestamp without time zone PROHIBITED. All timestamps MUST use TIMESTAMPTZ to preserve UTC offset.

INV6-BARE-TIMESTAMP-SQL.description: INV-6 (Universal UTC): Bare TIMESTAMP (without TZ) detected. Use TIMESTAMPTZ instead.

INV6-DEVICE-CLOCK-DEFAULT.description: INV-6: Device-clock column has DEFAULT NOW(). Server clock silently substitutes device anchor. DROP DEFAULT and force explicit insert.

INV-2-AUTH-UID.description: INV-2: auth.uid() is forbidden. Use auth.jwt() -> 'organization_id' claim for tenant isolation.

INV-2-RLS-INTEGRITY.description: INV-2: Mandatory RLS and Policy pattern verification for new tables.
